title: Real part of a mod-three complex term
statement: Let $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The real part of $(-\sqrt{3})^{|S|}\bigl(\prod_{i\in S}x_i\bigr)\,\mathrm{i}^{|S|}$ is $$\begin{cases}(-1)^{(|S|\bmod 4)/2}(\sqrt{3})^{|S|}\displaystyle\prod_{i\in S}x_i,&|S|\text{ is even},\\0,&|S|\text{ is odd}.�\end{cases}$$
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is a point of the sign cube
